# Code of Conduct

1. Please be kind to one another, remember the human.
2. Spam and unsolicited advertisements are not permitted.
3. Trolling, flaming, baiting or other attention-stealing behaviour is not allowed.
4. Discrimination or otherwise demeaning a group of people is not permitted, this is an inclusive space and you will respect this.
5. Harassment, threats, doxxing, and sharing private information without consent are not allowed.
6. Keep discussion on topic. Issues, pull requests and comments should help the project, not derail it.
7. Assume good faith. Disagree with ideas, not with people. Personal attacks are not allowed.
8. Do not impersonate maintainers, contributors, or official Klovy Chat accounts.
9. Do not post malware, exploit payloads, or instructions meant to harm users, services, or data.
10. Report security issues privately (see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)). Do not disclose them in public issues or pull requests.
11. Respect maintainers' decisions on what is merged, delayed, or closed. Repeated pressure after a decision has been made is not allowed.
12. Follow the [Klovy License](https://github.com/klovy-chat/backend/blob/main/LICENSE). Do not submit code you do not have the right to contribute.
13. These points are not an exhaustive list. Other reasonable standards of behaviour also apply even when they are not written down here. If something would be unwelcome, unsafe, or dishonest, do not do it.

Maintainers may warn, hide, close, or ban accounts that break this code. If you are unsure, ask before you post.
